sub: A saved recipe for launching instances.

Overview.p: A launch template stores instance settings (AMI, type, key pair, security groups, user data, tags) so you can launch the same server again and again. Auto Scaling uses it to create instances.
A saved order form. Instead of filling in the same details every time, you hand over the form.
A team keeps one launch template for its web tier. Auto Scaling uses it to add identical servers during a sale.

items: Works with Auto Scaling and Spot
Create a template with AMI, type, SG, key pair, user data
Reference it in an Auto Scaling Group
The ASG launches instances from it
Create a new version to change servers
